PALETTE.label: Palette (seasonal colour family — list all dominant colours)

COLOUR_PAIRING.label: Colour pairing (recurring two-tone or tonal combination)

COLOUR_ABSENCE.label: Colour absence (deliberate neutrality, e.g. The Row no-colour)

GARMENT_SILHOUETTE.label: Garment silhouette (A-line, column, cocoon, trapeze, etc.)

HEM.label: Hem length and shape (mini, midi, maxi, asymmetric, fringe)

SYMBOLIC_MOTIF.label: Symbolic motif (recurring branded symbol, e.g. Versace Medusa)

ARCHIVE_PRINT.label: Archive print (reissued historical motif from house archive)

SIGNATURE_MATERIAL.label: Signature material (named fabric specific to house, e.g. Hermès Barenia)

CONSTRUCTION_TECHNIQUE.label: Garment construction method (bias cut, laser-cut, pleating, layering, draping)

TEXTILE_TECHNIQUE.label: Textile fabrication technique (jacquard weave, boucle, intarsia, ribbing, horsehair)

SURFACE_TREATMENT.label: Surface finish applied post-fabrication (embossing, embroidery, gesso, gold leaf, quilting, patina)

MATERIAL_PROVENANCE.label: Material sourcing (region, heritage supplier, named mill)

CLOSURE_TYPE.label: Closure type (toggle, hook, button, zip, none)

SIGNATURE_HARDWARE.label: Signature hardware (e.g. Chanel chain, Hermès Kelly clasp)

INTERIOR_DETAIL.label: Interior detail (lining colour, stamp, stitch count)

GEOGRAPHIC_ORIGIN.label: Geographic origin or cultural territory (equestrian England, ancient Greece, Colombia)

MUSE.label: Muse (real or fictional person cited as inspiration)

ART_MOVEMENT.label: Art movement or discipline (architecture, textile art, dance, sculpture, painting)

SEASONAL_CONCEPT.label: Seasonal concept (explicitly stated show theme or title)

EMOTIONAL_TERRITORY.label: Recurring emotional territory (romanticism, rebellion, utility, sensoriality)

CUSTOMER_ARCHETYPE_HOUSE.label: Customer archetype as stated by the house in show notes or designer quotes

CUSTOMER_ARCHETYPE_OBSERVED.label: Customer archetype inferred by analysis from runway patterns, not stated by the house

BRAND_LANGUAGE.label: Brand language (naming conventions, copy tone, designer quotes as brand signal)
